clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Gnoarn worries that Bingles Blastenheimer has been missing for more than a week. The gnome aviator vanished during a flight toward fallen Gnomeregan, and Gnoarn sends searchers to the shores of Loch Modan. There, Bingles is alive and needs mechanical salvage.

Gnome aviator Bingles Blastenheimer was sent from Tinker Town in Ironforge on an aerial reconnaissance flight over the irradiated ruins of Gnomeregan. More than a week has passed without word, and Gnoarn fears Bingles may have blown himself out of the sky, a danger of gnome engineering. The last report placed the eccentric flyer somewhere above Loch Modan's waters.

Searchers find Bingles alive along the Loch Modan shoreline, far from a tragic pile of wreckage. He is unfazed by his long absence and takes slight offense that anyone doubted his piloting. Rather than return promptly to report to Gnoarn, Bingles enlists his rescuer to recover tools and Blastencapper explosives stolen by troggs. He wants them so he can resume his duties for the gnomish movement.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We've lost contact with Bingles! He was sent on a reconnaissance mission over Gnomeregan and hasn't reported back in over a week. I just know he's gone and blown himself up.
He was last seen flying over the Loch. Perhaps you can investigate, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So Gnoarn doesn't trust my reconnaissance abilities? I wonder why...
Nevermind that, I need your assistance! Nay! The movement needs your assistance!
